seo.title: Dr. Alba Lara | Psychiatrist and Psychotherapist in Austin
seo.description: Meet Dr. Alba Lara, a psychiatrist offering psychodynamic psychotherapy and medication management for adults in Austin and via telehealth.

providers.tagline: Her clinical focus includes mood disorders and the emotional effects of medical illness.
bioParagraphs: Dr. Alba Lara is a board-certified psychiatrist and psychotherapist. She completed psychiatry residency at UT Austin Dell Medical School and a consultation-liaison psychiatry fellowship at Columbia University.

Her work includes psychiatric care for mood disorders and for people whose mental health is affected by medical illness. She also offers psychodynamic psychotherapy, which explores patterns in emotional life and relationships.

financialPolicy.summary: Mariposa Psychiatry is private-pay and out of network with all insurance plans. The practice does not accept Medicare or Medicaid patients. A credit card must be kept on file and is charged on the day of your appointment.

faqs.question: Who does Dr. Lara see?
faqs.answer: Dr. Lara works with adults ages 18–64. Her practice focuses on psychodynamic psychotherapy, mood disorders, and mental health concerns that overlap with medical illness.

faqs.question: Is she accepting new patients?
faqs.answer: Yes, for care that fits the practice's clinical focus. Patients seeking both psychotherapy and psychiatric care with Dr. Lara are prioritized. Submit an inquiry to explore whether the practice is a fit for your needs.

faqs.question: Are appointments online or in person?
faqs.answer: Most appointments are online, with limited in-person availability in Northwest Austin on Tuesdays. Telehealth is available to patients located in Texas, California, Arizona, New Mexico, Missouri, or New York.

faqs.question: Does the practice accept insurance?
faqs.answer: Mariposa Psychiatry is private-pay and out of network with all insurance plans. The practice does not accept Medicare or Medicaid patients.

faqs.question: How does payment work?
faqs.answer: A credit card must be kept on file and is charged on the day of the appointment. Visit fees are listed in the Private Pay section.

faqs.question: What happens after I submit an inquiry?
faqs.answer: Dr. Lara reviews the information to assess whether she can provide the care you need and contacts you about next steps. Submitting an inquiry does not confirm an appointment or acceptance into the practice.
